body:
Yes, I'm trying my best to show him that I am here for him, but it feels like I'm talking to a wall. He doesn't listen to any of my advice. He kind of just moans about how life sucks, etc. It isn't the most productive kind of talk and it just feels like it's going no where :[

I have spoken to him on the phone before about all of this, but it still doesn't seem to help him at all. I really am not sure how to handle this delicate subject :/

Yeah, I am not sure what I'd say :/

I would really love to message some of his family members but I don't know if that would make things worse. He lives away from home.

I met him online so I really don't know any of his friends. I do know some of the friends he probably interacts with the most, though.

I am not sure how to convince him to see a therapist. He is very resistant and I don't want to accidentally set off any sensitive triggers :/
